description: NaCaPrSeO₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic F̅43m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent PrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent CaO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent SeO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.83 Å. Ca is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form CaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SeO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent PrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ca-O bond lengths are 2.19 Å. Pr is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form PrO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent PrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent CaO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent SeO₆ octahedra. All Pr-O bond lengths are 2.83 Å. Se is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form SeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CaO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent PrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Se-O bond lengths are 1.80 Å. O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, two equivalent Pr, and one Se atom.
